name: Oklahoma
notes: Oklahoma supports digital ID (Oklahoma Digital ID) through Apple Wallet. Google Wallet, Samsung Wallet, and a dedicated state app are not currently supported — the previous Oklahoma Mobile ID app was decommissioned in 2024.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 16.5 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or ID', then select Oklahoma.
Choose to add it to your iPhone only, or to both your iPhone and a paired Apple Watch (watchOS 11 or later required for Watch).
Follow the onscreen prompts to scan the front and back of your physical Oklahoma driver's license or State ID.
Your request is sent to Oklahoma DPS. Once approved, your ID will appear in Apple Wallet.
Manage your Digital ID (verify, deactivate, or delete) anytime at navigate.ok.gov.
